features.name: ordinary_file_annotations
features.scope: Ordinary Kotlin FILE annotations with imported/canonical resolution, argument and target checking, SOURCE/BINARY/RUNTIME retention, facade-only emission, class-only validation and official Java/Kotlin consumers.
restrictions: Compiler-semantic annotations including OptIn/Suppress and JVM file lowering remain explicit unsupported boundaries; grouped and annotation-only headers remain unsupported.
Bounded annotation-definition support prevents argument validation for one oracle-invalid OptIn input. It is recorded as unsupported with official_accepted:false, not an invalid-input rejection pass.
Actual AndroidBible files remain explicitly blocked; no whole-file/app, Android runtime or performance claim.

history: The first file-annotation report failed four diagnostic expectations. Fresh v2 evidence supersedes it; historical cases remain unchanged.
